## Open

### F-277 — The CLI demo test promised a clean stderr, which a loaded runner cannot keep

> _2026-09-26 · demo/blong-cli · open_

CI failed the demo's first test with twelve warn lines on stderr: the framework's slow-step warnings
for `start adapter` (2079ms) and `start text` (1470ms), which a shared runner produces routinely
while a quiet machine does not. The assertion is about the command's contract — the result is the
only thing on stdout, and nothing of the command's own reaches stderr — and the framework's
diagnostics are not the command's output, but they arrive on the same stream. Fix: every invocation
in the test passes `--log.slowMs=60000`, the mechanism the loader documents for a machine that is
legitimately slow, so the strict assertion stays and still asserts what it means. Filtering
framework lines out of stderr was the alternative and was rejected: it would encode the log's line
format in a test, and hide a diagnostic that really is unexpected.
